decisions.rationale: MeshFrameCodec documents and encodes only dest, src, hopLimit, flags, then inner bytes; repo grep found no source-route/hop-list field in the mesh frame codec.
HandleInboundAsync delivers only when dest==self; otherwise it calls _router.TryNextHop(dest,out next), re-encodes with hop-1, and sends to that next hop. No sender path intent is read.
AddNeighborNoLock seeds a direct route with NextHop=neighbor, TryNextHop returns reachable entries, and HandleInboundAsync returns on dest==self before the forwarding/no-route branches.

The DV tie rule keeps incumbents for equal-cost alternatives, but the claim's premise that any non-adjacent ring target has equal clockwise/counter-clockwise cost is false; repo has a ring-5 scenario where 1->3 paths are length 2 and 3.
MeshRouter and MeshNodeRuntime exist as described, but they are not the only relay implementations: MeshRelayRoute is another relay class using IDistanceVectorRouter and TryNextHop.
MeshNodeRuntime writes _pending at send, scans it in RetransmitLoopAsync, and removes only in the deadline branch. Repo-scope grep found no ACK/receipt removal path in mesh runtime.
Accepted is documented as handed to the current next hop and registered for retransmit; SendAsync returns Accepted immediately after TrySendToNeighborAsync, not after delivery or acknowledgement.
RetransmitLoopAsync resends every non-expired pending entry over the current best next hop; defaults are 50ms retransmit and 5000ms TTL, and bench profile default TTL is 120s.

Delivery increments _delivered but does not clear _pending; expiry later removes the pending key and StageExpiredToPartitionQueue increments _dropped, so a delivered accepted message can later count as dropped.
Dropped is documented as no-route/hop-exhausted/malformed/failed send, but StageExpiredToPartitionQueue, called on TTL expiry, increments the same _dropped counter.

The suite does exercise pending TTL expiry: MeshTelemetryTests sets MessageTtl to 300ms and asserts MessageExpired fires after TTL. Mesh tests also use 5s WaitUntil windows, not only 150-400ms settles.
The cited grep pattern finds only the TODO, but Link/Secure contains shipped integrity/authentication: AES-GCM TryOpen returns false on tamper/wrong key and SecureLinkTransport performs a pin check.
MeshSendOutcome is a byte enum with exactly Accepted, DeliveredLocal, Unreachable, and Dropped. There is no signature/integrity failure outcome in that closed set.
The pump catches and swallows all HandleInboundAsync exceptions, and malformed mesh prefixes return silently as a conserved skip. Exceptions cannot express a propagated HALT in this pump.
MarkDown latches once, removes the neighbor, calls SetLinkState(false), advertises, and disposes the link. Retransmit later uses the current TryNextHop, while DeliverAsync dedups by key.
MeshBenchProfile.Parse accepts only line/triangle/diamond shapes and bringup/e2e-delivery/failover/heal/partition/kv-flow scenarios; unknown values return Invalid.
Parse refuses secure:false and missing pinnedSpki. BenchLinkComposer says no configuration skips the secure wrap and disposes the raw link on non-established outcomes.

BlueZL2capSocketFactory is the only L2CAP socket factory file; it guards with OperatingSystem.IsLinux and throws PlatformNotSupportedException otherwise. AF_BLUETOOTH is hardcoded as Linux 31 with Windows noted as 32.
LinkScheme.BleL2cap is documented as a scheme stub/no transport, but L2capLinkTransport implements ILinkTransport and supports LinkScheme.BleL2cap.
Repo-scope file listing under Link has no *Rfcomm* transport files. Rfcomm appears as prose in LinkTerms naming WindowsRfcommTransport/AndroidRfcommTransport leaves.
LinkSinkAdapter explicitly says true means written to transport, receipt is not confirmed end-to-end, and a raw link has no ack channel.
FailoverTests build a FakeFabric, converge/cut links, and assert TryNextHop/Snapshot cost. The file contains no SendAsync, inbox, or delivery assertion.

SC-001 sends one message, but the repo-scope absence claim is false: Tests/Mesh contains an explicit ring-5 scenario in DeterminismTests, contradicting the cited grep result saying no ring occurrence.
MeshNodeRuntime has a TODO stating restart/rejoin should rehydrate routing identity and in-flight outbox; this MVP keeps the source outbox in memory and restart re-floods from scratch.

StageExpiredToPartitionQueue is a TODO for durable per-partition queue/re-drive; current behavior emits telemetry if any and increments _dropped at expiry, with no parking or heal re-drive code there.
Docs say adverts ride the same neighbor links as data, demuxed by flags. AdvertiseToAllAsync uses TrySendToNeighborAsync, which serializes all sends through the neighbor SendGate.
MeshRouter, MeshFrameCodec, and MeshRelayRoute all document that relays forward opaque inner payload bytes and never decode/read the envelope; only the destination interprets it.
MessageForwarded telemetry unwraps KeyedFrame only after a null-telemetry check and calls SafeObserve; SafeObserve catches observer throws, and options document telemetry as observe-only.

The claim says no membership-change API exists, but MeshNodeRuntime exposes AddNeighbor and RemoveNeighborAsync, and telemetry documents administrative neighbor removal. That disproves the asserted absence.
